text: {"lessons":["My account value has moved up and down even in months when I made no trades, so I should assess progress across many periods rather than chase monthly results.","I added to several holdings after prices had fallen, but a lower price alone does not show that a stock is a good buy; I should use consistent criteria before adding shares.","Before placing trades, I should check how each purchase changes my exposure across the five stocks and how much cash I retain for future needs."]}
